notes.title: Hotfix 2.1b
notes.notes:
Hello All;

Today I released the 2.1b patch / hotfix, which does the following:


 Fixed fast camera speed when aiming Game pad / mouse (Slowed down & much more accurate)
 Fixed game pad overpowered putt / chip bug (It chipped & Putted 10% harder than the mouse & keyboard controls, making it impossible to do trick target shots.)
 Fixed a couple minor / misc bugs.


Thank all, enjoy the update.

- The Dev

notes.title: New Update Coming.
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Golfers!

Well I am a little sad to say that this game I made for my son is not selling, maybe 1 or 2 copies a month. As dis-heartening as this is I still have decided to work on a new update for the game, which will feature a few changes and improvements for the very few that purchased it as a thank you. However it is still a ways off due to the amount of work it entails and I need to focus most of my work day on what pays the bills.

Now with that said I am working on a few things:

#1) Gameplay mechanics, although it is controlled the same, the controls have been coded from scratch along with the camera system to address some of the issues that people were talking about or emailed me about previously (ie hole over view at the start of each hole e.t.c). 

#2) MUCH BETTER Physics, ramps up the challenge of the courses a little, ie you can not clock the ball at the hole and expect it to go in, oh no no no now you have to use the right amount of power to get it in. The previous version was really to aid my son in playing it but now realize that mass market wants more of a challenge hahaha.

#3) Improved Graphics in some areas.

#4) Newly designed courses from the ground up.

#5) A few other surprises to be announced at a later date.

So please bare with me as I get this all together, in the meantime remember to play the other free game included with it! 

Kindest Regards;

The Dev
